name: uv_mutex_init

ownership.argument: Initializes the pthread-backed mutex used by the Feature manager. Corrects earlier record 0xC2DCF1C, a different initializer; use this matched libuv init/lock/unlock family.

provenance.source: Feature manager constructor 0xC8656D8 calls 0xC2DCCCC(manager+32). Wrapper uses mutexattr_init 0xC1E9AAC, settype(attr,1) 0xC1E9AF4, mutex_init 0xC204DB4 and attr_destroy 0xC1E9AD0; returns negated pthread error. Source literal ../../apps/system/libuv/libuv/src/unix/thread.c.

notes: Initializes the pthread-backed mutex used by the Feature manager. Corrects earlier record 0xC2DCF1C, a different initializer; use this matched libuv init/lock/unlock family.
